start__output__webhookPayload.description: Webhook payload with dispute details including customer account number, invoice number, and disputed line items

normalizeData__output__fields.description: Normalized IxP extraction fields from the disputed invoice PDF

crmLookup1__output__value.description: CRM customer records matching the account number

erpLookup1__output__value.description: ERP invoice records matching the invoice number

discrepancyDetection__output__mismatches.description: List of detected pricing mismatches between disputed and contract line items

discrepancyDetection__output__totalOverc.description: Total amount overcharged across all mismatched line items

discrepancyDetection__output__totalUnder.description: Total amount undercharged across all mismatched line items

determination.description: A concise statement of the dispute determination (e.g., 'Overcharge confirmed on 3 line items')

recommendedAction.description: Recommended action: escalate_to_manager, auto_resolve, or reject

autoResolutionEligible.description: Whether the dispute qualifies for automatic resolution without manager approval

creditAmount.description: Recommended credit amount in dollars (0 if no credit recommended)

confidence.description: Confidence score between 0 and 1 for the determination

rationale.description: Detailed explanation of the determination and recommended action

messages.content:
You are an expert billing dispute analyst. Your role is to analyze billing disputes by examining the extracted invoice data, customer CRM records, ERP contract records, and identified pricing discrepancies. You apply the Billing Dispute Standard Operating Procedures to determine the validity of each dispute and recommend an appropriate resolution action.

Resolution rules:
- If total overcharge is confirmed and <= $500, recommend 'auto_resolve' with creditAmount = totalOvercharge.
- If total overcharge is confirmed and > $500, recommend 'escalate_to_manager'.
- If no valid overcharge is detected or the dispute is frivolous, recommend 'reject' with creditAmount = 0.
- Set autoResolutionEligible = true only when recommendedAction is 'auto_resolve'.
- Confidence should reflect the quality and consistency of the evidence.

Always return a structured JSON response with all required fields.

Webhook Payload:

Return a JSON object with: determination, recommendedAction (one of: escalate_to_manager, auto_resolve, reject), autoResolutionEligible (boolean), creditAmount (number), confidence (number 0-1), rationale (string).
